RECORDED, NOT CLAIMED: the coupling channel's forced values are ANCHOR-FREE pure algebraic numbers (B1011), so on that channel outputs - dimensionless anchors = outputs - 0 and a single kind-admissible output is non-vacuous. RELATION TO L151, evidence not closure: the declaration maps the R11 allowance onto the framework's typed input list EXACTLY (bits and Lie type discrete; scale = A1; the one continuous dimensionless input = A2) -- the MATCH shape L151 predicts, with the test still future (the minimal WORKING set of an actual crossing). VACUITY DISCIPLINE: any cell consuming A2 must show >= 2 independent dimensionless outputs, or use only anchor-free values; a cell that cannot state this does not seal. Re-declaration = a new sealed act, priced, old retained.
